issuer: the Public Entity Saba (the Lieutenant Governor)
note: Read 2026-10-30. Each of the three public bodies keeps its own road traffic ordinance and issues its own licences, so the Caribbean Netherlands is kept by its islands. Saba's Island Ordinance containing rules for traffic and road safety (in force from 5 June 2022, CVDR740839, version 2, published in English): licences are issued by or on behalf of the Lieutenant Governor; a licence is issued for the first time only to someone who has reached 18 (21 for the categories of Art. 101(1)(c), (d) and (f)) (Art. 102) and is valid five years from issue (Art. 109). Fee: the only tariff found is the island decree fixing the charges of the Retributieverordening 2007 (in force as published from 10 October 2010, CVDR45535/2): 'Rijbewijs (per categorie) 250,00', a figure of 2010 with no currency named beside it, while the file's currency is the US dollar (the gazetteer's for the island); no tariff in dollars was found, so the fee is null.

sources.title: Island Ordinance containing rules for traffic and road safety on the roads of Saba (lokaleregelgeving.overheid.nl, CVDR740839/2)
sources.said: Island Ordinance containing rules for traffic and road safety on the roads of Saba ... Geldend van 05-06-2022 t/m heden ... issued by or on behalf of the Lieutenant Governor ... shall only be issued for the first time to the person who: ... has reached the age of 18, on the understanding that the driver of motor vehicles as referred to in Article 101, first paragraph, subparagraphs c, d and f, must have reached the age of 21; ... A driver’s license issued pursuant to Article 100, first paragraph, shall be valid for five years, counting from the date of issue.
